messages:
Alex (oncall): ok i'm taking the 00:00-08:00 primary. quick sync: three active alerts i care about right now — kv-cache eviction noise in eu1, tokenstore 5xx spike in prod, and an elevated p99 on regen paths. i don't see a full customer outage but some customers are seeing higher tail latencies.
Priya: i'm secondary for the shift. can pick up any paging if Alex needs to hand off.
incident-bot: [ALERT] kv-cache-evictions-high (eu1) triggered at 2026-03-15T23:45:02Z — severity: P2 — assigned: eng-oncall
Sam-Infra: i'm online. i'll take tokenstore errors unless someone else is closer.
Jorge: i'm watching the regen p99. seeing a pattern where long prompts are suffering more.
Alex (oncall): current mitigations in place: scaled kv-cache pool by +2 nodes (eu1-cache-pool), enabled eviction-protect mode for high-frequency keys, temporarily disabled prefetch for embeddings-heavy customers (CLI: `redwood cache set --prefetch false --region eu1`).
Alex (oncall): tokenstore: rolling restart in progress of ws-tokenstore-3. deploy-bot: `Started rollout of tokenstore/v2.1.4 -> tokenstore (prod)`
deploy-bot: rollout id d6f2a3 started by Sam-Infra at 2026-03-15T23:52:10Z.
Sam-Infra: command used: ```kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/tokenstore && kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=tokenstore -w```
Priya: runbook pointers: see runbook — https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tokenstore-5xx. follow section 'quick rollback' if rollout increases 5xx.
Jorge: customer impact note: Customer AcmeCorp reported 502s at 23:43 UTC, region eu-west_1 routing to eu1. ticket INC-2026 created in Zendesk.
Alex (oncall): action items for primary: 1) confirm tokenstore rollout stabilizes (watch 5xx rate for 10m), 2) keep kv-cache nodes scaled while we observe p99, 3) if regressions continue, failover traffic for heavy embedding customers to us-west warmstart pool.
Priya: action items for secondary: 1) be ready to swap prim/sec if any pager escalates, 2) coordinate with Sam on rollback if tokenstore 5xx > 1% of requests for 5m, 3) post customer comms draft if AcmeCorp impact persists (>10min).
Sam-Infra: observed tokenstore pod restart count: pod/tokenstore-3 restarted once, logs show transient DB connection timeout to tokendb-read. tail logs: ```ERROR tokendb: timeout after 3s connecting to tokendb-read-01:5432```
Alex (oncall): tokendb team pinged — they saw a brief network flapping in us-east-2 but claim no config changes. Sam, can you open a tokendb support ticket if restarts continue?
Sam-Infra: opening ticket now (TICKET-7432). cc @db-team.
incident-bot: [NOTE] Page silence option: if tokenstore 5xx drops below threshold, alert will auto-resolve in 6m.
Jorge: regen p99: currently 1.8s -> baseline 0.9s. skew concentrated on sequences > 1024 tokens. possible kv-cache miss spike.
Alex (oncall): short-term mitigation for regen: enable prefix-caching for known prefixes for affected clients and shorten max-concurrency for regen workers in eu1: `redwood service set --name regen --concurrency 4 --region eu1`
Priya: i'm updating the shift doc with primary/secondary and runbook links: https://redwood.internal/oncall/shifts/2026-03-15-night. adding triage notes for INC-2026 and TICKET-7432.
Alex (oncall): communication plan: no broad customer email yet. if AcmeCorp still impacted after 15m escalate to support-eng and drafting a status update. if multiple customers degrade, we'll follow incident bridge template and open a public status.
Sam-Infra: tokenstore rollout currently at 60% pods updated; 5xx rate dropped from 0.7% -> 0.2% in last 4m. i'll keep watch.
Jorge: regen p99 improved slightly after cache scaling but still ~1.5s. suspicious tail evictions still happening.
Alex (oncall): ok keep watch. if kv-cache evictions don't go under threshold in next 12m, prepare to run cache-eviction-snapshot script and escalate to caching-owners. command: ```python tools/eviction_snapshot.py --region eu1 --top 50 > /tmp/evict-eu1-$(date +%s).json```
Priya: noted. i'm standby to take over if anything pages.
Sam-Infra: recorded rollout logs + current metrics snapshot in the incident channel. link: https://redwood.internal/logs/rollouts/d6f2a3
Alex (oncall): leaving this thread for continuity. if you get paged, respond here with short status. i'll do a handback at 06:00 UTC and summarize outstanding items. :eyes:
Priya: ack. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: [RESOLVE?] kv-cache-evictions-high will auto-resolve if metrics normalize.
Jorge: will ping again if regen tail crosses 2.0s.
Sam-Infra: tokenstore rollout currently stable at 95%, 5xx now ~0.05%. closing immediate rollback window.
Alex (oncall): thanks all — leave notes in the shift doc with timelines. final check: nothing customer-facing yet but watch AcmeCorp ticket.
Priya: closing note: primary/secondary set on doc, runbooks linked, tickets created: INC-2026, TICKET-7432.
